Recently retired Certifications

These Certifications have been retired within the last year. When a Certification has been retired for more than one year, it will be removed from this page. Once a Certification has been retired, it will no longer be available in the Certification offerings. If you earned or renewed a Certification before it was retired, it will remain on your transcript in the Active Certifications section until it expires. Once the Certification expires, it will move the Historical Certifications section of your transcript.
